- Sep: 30 days (31 total)
- Oct: 31 days (62 total)
- Nov: 30 days (92 total)
- Dec: 31 days (123 total)
- Jan 2025: 31 days (154 total)
- Feb 2025: 28 days (182 total, 2025 not a leap year)
- Mar: 17 days (199 total)
Result: 2025-03-17
